امتعضتن (form VIII)
# اِمْتَعَضْتُنَّ (imtaʕaḍtunna) /im.ta.ʕadˤ.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِمْتَعَضَ (imtaʕaḍa)
# اُمْتُعِضْتُنَّ (umtuʕiḍtunna) /um.tu.ʕidˤ.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِمْتَعَضَ (imtaʕaḍa)
